title: Tyla - Chanel STEP BY STEP Dance Tutorial (Explained) | Easy to Follow for Beginners

method.teacher_system: The teacher demonstrates the routine phrase by phrase, breaking down each move with counts and clear verbal instructions, then drills each segment before combining them into a full-speed practice.

practices.what: The teacher introduces mirrored teaching so the viewer can follow along directly without flipping left and right.
The teacher breaks down the choreography into smaller, manageable pieces, starting with the very first freeze and body wave.
The teacher uses vocal counts and spoken musical cues to guide the rhythm for each movement.
The teacher repeats the breakdown of the body wave multiple times to ensure clarity before moving on.
The teacher introduces the next segment of the choreography involving jumping and footwork details.
The teacher breaks down the hand wiping and hip movement sequence with detailed counts.
The teacher reviews the learned chunks together and repeats them twice at a steady pace.
The teacher teaches the next section featuring arm extensions and stepping close combinations.
The teacher demonstrates the final turn and head-arm coordination sequence step by step.
The teacher guides a complete recap of all learned segments from the freeze onwards.
The teacher performs the full routine with the music at normal speed for final follow-along practice.

adaptations.difficulty: The video pace might be too fast for complete beginners.
adaptations.adjustment: Adjust the playback speed to 0.5x or 0.75x in the YouTube settings.

adaptations.difficulty: Doing the body wave choreography alone versus with friends.
adaptations.adjustment: Adapt the spacing or positioning depending on whether you are dancing solo or facing a partner.

adaptations.difficulty: Where to place the non-working hand during the hip movement.
adaptations.adjustment: Place the hand on your thighs or keep it free depending on comfort.

adaptations.difficulty: Following the full speed choreography with music.
adaptations.adjustment: Adjust the YouTube speed settings to 1.5x for a faster pace or 2.0x for normal speed.

beliefs.belief: Learners can adjust video playback speeds to match their learning pace.

moments.says: The teacher greets the learner and welcomes them to the dance tutorial channel.
The teacher advises adjusting the video speed in YouTube settings if the choreography feels too fast.
The teacher recaps the steps after practicing them all together.
The teacher concludes the video, hopes the learner learned something, and invites them to subscribe and check out other tutorials.

mentor.what_stays: The teacher leaves the learner feeling encouraged and equipped to master the choreography at their own pace.
